title: FLA import: motionOrientToPath flag silently skipped at line 1837
description: flash8-binary.ts r.skip(4) at line 1837 (inside fs>13 block) discards the motionTweenSnap/orient-to-path u32 flag. flash8-import.ts never sets motionOrientToPath on a keyframe so it's always false for real FLAs. Model, interpolator (timeline-query.ts:223), and Timeline.tsx checkbox are all wired up — just the FLA read is missing. Fix: decode u32 and pass motionOrientToPath to createFrame.
